name: Glare Hover

angle.description: Direction of the band, in degrees.

size.description: Size of the gradient band, as a percentage of the host.

playOnce.description: Snap back instantly on leave instead of sliding out.

a11y: The glare is a pseudo-element, so it is not in the accessibility tree.
Keyboard focus (:focus-visible / :focus-within) plays the same sweep as hover.
Opacity is capped at 0.6 so text keeps its contrast while the band passes over it.
The host's own focus outline is untouched.
